report.headline: Usage rate projected to drop from 19.9% in the G League to 15.5% in the NBA, below the league's 20.0% average, while the true-shooting projection carries no signal

projection.text: The model projects a 15.5% usage rate in the NBA, down from the 19.9% usage the subject carried in the source G League season and below the 20.0% minutes-weighted NBA average that season; this sits close to the naive z-preservation baseline of 19.9% only if standing were fully preserved, but lands nearer the folk 0.75x rule's 15.0% estimate.

risks.text: Projected NBA usage of 15.5% represents a real decline from the 19.9% usage rate carried in the G League and falls below the NBA's 20.0% average usage that season.
The usage model's out-of-fold error (3.3%) only modestly beats the trivial league-mean baseline's error (4.3%), limiting how much confidence the point projection deserves.

The true shooting projection of 53.9% should not be trusted: the model's 4.7% error is identical to the 4.7% error of simply guessing the league average, meaning this metric carries no information here.
The projection rests on only 45 historical GL->NBA transitions, a thin base for the fitted slopes of 0.531 on usage and 0.801 on true shooting.

strengths.text: In the source season the subject posted a true shooting percentage of 57.3%, 0.36 standard deviations above the G League mean that year.

Players who historically made this exact GL->NBA move already sat 0.27 standard deviations above their own league's average, indicating the subject was drawn from a cohort that outperformed its league before the transition.
The subject sustained a full role in the source season, playing 1,525 minutes across 50 games with per-75 rates of 17.54 points and 10.859 rebounds.

uncertainty.text: The 80% prediction interval for usage rate runs from 10.3% to 20.7% — a span of over 10 percentage points against a league standard deviation of 5.2% — and the 95% interval widens to 7.5%-23.5%, wide enough to rank this player against peers but not to price his specific role.
